rule.description: Block obvious env, Git, PHP and WordPress probes on static website hosts
rule.expression: (http.host in {"jes.bz" "www.jes.bz"} and (lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.env" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/.git/" or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.git") or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".php") or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php/" or ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".phtml") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) in {"/wp-admin" "/wp-content" "/wp-includes"}))

rule.description: Block obvious env, Git, PHP and WordPress probes on static website hosts
